name: @openclaw-pets/desktop
description: Native macOS desktop companion for OpenClaw Pets

scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @openclaw-pets/protocol build && corepack pnpm --filter @openclaw-pets/petpack build && vue-tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @openclaw-pets/protocol build && corepack pnpm --filter @openclaw-pets/petpack build && vitest run
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @openclaw-pets/protocol build && corepack pnpm --filter @openclaw-pets/petpack build && vue-tsc --noEmit
